name: Sous-titres
description: Transcribes the sequence's audio with the built-in Whisper speech recogniser, lays the words out as a caption track, and can write an .srt next to the project. Needs a FilmCraft built with speech-to-text and the speech model installed (Edit > Preferences > Media Analysis & Transcription). The transcription runs on the CPU and can take a while on long sequences.
author: FilmCraft

entries.label: Générer les sous-titres
entries.description: Transcribe, then create a caption track named Sous-titres (42 characters per line, 2 lines).

entries.label: Générer et exporter en .srt
entries.description: As above, then write <project>.srt next to the saved project.

entries.label: Exporter les sous-titres en .srt
entries.description: Write the first caption track of the sequence to <project>.srt.
